summary: Added FAIL_ROUTING_AGENT_MAP constant to orchestrator/src/config.py. The constant is derived from pipelines.fail_routing in shared/workflow-manifest.json by inverting role IDs to role names via the _roles list. Includes a _resolve_fail_routing_role helper with a StopIteration guard that raises ImportError with a descriptive message if a manifest role ID is unresolvable. All 6 pipeline types are present as keys with correct role name values (Developer, Release Engineer, Documentation). All 251 existing orchestrator tests pass.
